SHENSHEN-LITTLE_FIREBALL.title: Little Fireball
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_SHIELD.title: Light Shield
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK.title: Light Mark
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, then mark the enemy for {Turns:diff()} turns.
Each hit from your attacks deals {BurnDamage:diff()} extra burn damage to the marked enemy. Burn is blocked normally.
SHENSHEN-CLAW_STRIKE.title: Claw Strike
SHENSHEN-CLAW_STRIKE.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Normally hits 3 times; hits 4 times if you transformed this turn.
SHENSHEN-MI_DODGE.title: Mew Guard
SHENSHEN-CAT_TAIL_SWEEP.title: Cat Tail Sweep
SHENSHEN-I_DONT_LIKE_YOU.title: I Don't Like You!
SHENSHEN-I_DONT_LIKE_YOU.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
The enemy gains {EnemyStrength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MIRROR.title: Light Mirror
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MIRROR.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Until your next turn, reflect damage blocked from attacks back to the attacker.
Repeated casts do not multiply or extend reflection.
SHENSHEN-TRANSFORMATION_MAGIC.title: Transformation Magic
SHENSHEN-TRANSFORMATION_MAGIC.descriptio:
Switch between girl and cat form.
To cat: gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: and {ThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold]}.
To girl: gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: and {Block:diff()} fixed [gold]Block[/gold]}.
Discard your current form's cards, then draw that many from your owned new form deck. Return this card to hand.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING.title: Light Blessing
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Bless another player. Before their next normal draw, they choose {Cards:diff()} extra cards from their draw pile to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP.title: Fluffed Up
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
After activation, gain {ThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] the first time you lose HP to an enemy attack this combat.{IfUpgraded:show:
Gain {LaterThorns:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] on each later enemy attack hit that causes HP loss, and {DebuffThorns:diff()} for each different debuff an enemy successfully applies.}
Persists across forms. Additional copies do not stack or reset the first-hit reward.
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR.title: Shattered Mirror
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Until your next turn, only the Block supplied by this card reflects the attack damage it blocks, across any number of hits.
SHENSHEN-THORN_PRAYER.title: Thorn Prayer
SHENSHEN-THORN_PRAYER.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {ThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] for this combat.
SHENSHEN-LIGHTFOOT_BLESSING.title: Lightfoot Blessing
SHENSHEN-LIGHTFOOT_BLESSING.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] until your next turn. Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_CURTAIN.title: Light Curtain
SHENSHEN-LINGERING_LIGHT.title: Lingering Light
SHENSHEN-LINGERING_LIGHT.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. You may put 1 cat card from your discard pile on top of your cat draw pile.
SHENSHEN-TWIN_SPARKS.title: Twin Sparks
SHENSHEN-CHASING_FLAME.title: Chasing Flame
SHENSHEN-CHASING_FLAME.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the enemy has your [gold]Light Mark[/gold], deal {MarkedDamage:diff()} damage instead.
SHENSHEN-DAZZLING_LIGHT.title: Dazzling Light
SHENSHEN-HALO.title: Halo
SHENSHEN-HALO.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. If you have [gold]Thorns[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SHENSHEN-REFRACTED_VOLLEY.title: Refracted Volley
SHENSHEN-REFRACTED_VOLLEY.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times. If you had [gold]Block[/gold] before playing this, draw {Cards:diff()} card.
SHENSHEN-ARCHED_BACK.title: Arched Back
SHENSHEN-ARCHED_BACK.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Gain {ThornsPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Thorns[/gold] until your next turn.
SHENSHEN-FURBALL_CURL.title: Furball Curl
SHENSHEN-FURBALL_CURL.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Gain {ThornsPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Thorns[/gold] until your next turn.
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK.title: Curious Peek
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. After your next transformation this turn, draw {ShiftCards:diff()} additional card(s) from your new form.
SHENSHEN-CATNAP.title: Catnap
SHENSHEN-CATNAP.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
Draw {Cards:diff()} card. Gain {Energy:diff()} additional Energy next turn.
SHENSHEN-GROOMING.title: Grooming
SHENSHEN-GROOMING.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
Draw {Cards:diff()} card. If you have [gold]Thorns[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SHENSHEN-SHED_FUR.title: Shed Fur
SHENSHEN-SHED_FUR.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Includes your current [gold]Thorns[/gold] amount without consuming it.
SHENSHEN-SWEEPING_CLAWS.title: Sweeping Claws
SHENSHEN-SWEEPING_CLAWS.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
SHENSHEN-BUNNY_KICK.title: Bunny Kick
SHENSHEN-BITE_THE_OPENING.title: Bite the Opening
SHENSHEN-BACKWARD_GLANCE.title: Backward Glance
SHENSHEN-BACKWARD_GLANCE.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. You may put 1 girl card from your discard pile on top of your girl draw pile.
SHENSHEN-LINGERING_LIGHT.selectionScreen: You may put 1 discarded cat card on top of your cat draw pile.
SHENSHEN-BACKWARD_GLANCE.selectionScreen: You may put 1 discarded girl card on top of your girl draw pile.
